display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center; width: 400px;

span.p:
Legend: each point is a measured configuration
Vertical axis: Quality (0.6 to 1.0)
Horizontal axis: Latency (0.1s, 0.5s, 1.0s, 2.0s, 5.0s)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center; width: 400px;

span.p:
Each column is a different model or configuration.
The Pareto frontier is the set of points where
no improvement in one dimension is possible
without degrading another.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center; width: 400px;

span.p:
Optimal configurations for different scenarios:
- Real-time chat: (0.95 quality, 0.5s latency, $0.02)
- Batch processing: (0.85 quality, 5.0s latency, $0.003)
- Enterprise: (1.0 quality, 1.0s latency, $0.05)
